tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.name: Section Name
Custom label for this entry in the list on the left. Purely cosmetic, pick anything that helps you organize your frames.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.item: Comma-separated item ids this frame applies to, e.g. minecraft:diamond_sword, minecraft:netherite_sword.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.tags: Comma-separated item tags this frame applies to, e.g. minecraft:planks.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.name: Namespace
Applies the frame to every item of a mod id, e.g. minecraft or companions.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.rari: Comma-separated rarities to match (rarity name): common, uncommon, rare, epic (or modded rarity names).
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.text: Optional background texture (namespace:path/to/texture.png) drawn inside the tooltip.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.back: Tooltip background color as #AARRGGBB. Click the color picker to pick one visually.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.bord: gradient / glint / static use the gradient colors. The auto_ variants pick the colors from the texture.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.inne: Shape of the inner frame corners.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.grad: Preset palette used by the border. 'custom' uses the Gradient Colors field below.
Up to three colors used when the gradient preset is set to custom. Click a color picker to edit it or the + to add a color.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.disa: Hides the item icon on the tooltip.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.icon: Decoration drawn behind the item icon.
Animation the icon plays when the tooltip appears.
Scale multiplier for the floating icon. 1.0 is the default size.
Rotation speed used by the rotating icon animations.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.titl: Horizontal alignment of the item name.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.show: Shows the rating/rarity line under the title.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.item: Free text shown as the item's rating, e.g. S+ or 9/10.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.colo: Color of the rating text, in case it's custom.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.rati: Horizontal alignment of the rating line.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.tool: Horizontal offset in pixels applied to the whole tooltip.
Vertical offset in pixels applied to the whole tooltip.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.main: Horizontal inner padding of the main panel.
Vertical inner padding of the main panel.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.disa: Hides the divider line under the title.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.divi: How the divider line is colored.
Extra spacing above the divider line.
Extra spacing below the divider line.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.show: Shows the side panel with a 3D preview for armor and tools.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.prev: Model rendered in the side panel for armor pieces.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.useP: Uses your own skin for the player model in the side panel.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.seco: Horizontal offset of the side panel.
Vertical offset of the side panel.
Rotation speed of the model in the side panel.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.spec: Comma-separated effects: bubbles, cinder, crystals, fireflies, echo, galaxy, magic_orbs, speed_lines, nebula, spiral, white_dust, metal_shining, rim_light, ripples, sonar, stars.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.vign: List of (type, position, color, radius, offsetX, offsetY) tuples, e.g. (circular, center, #80000000, 0.5, 0, 0). Types: circular, hole.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.tool: In/out animation played when the tooltip appears/disappears.
Duration of the appear/disappear animation in seconds, e.g. 0.15.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.show: Draws a drop shadow behind the tooltip.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.disa: Disables auto-scrolling for tooltips taller than the screen.
Completely hides the tooltip for the matched items.
